degree_descent.celestial_range: Strongest celestial concentration at T19-T22 (Greatness, First Father attributes, Land of Light, Eternity) with T25 immediately after. Earlier celestial peaks at T3 (Three Principles at Three Degrees), T7 (Five Fathers), T11 (Chain of Origins). Late celestial returns at T64 (Love as bond of Greatness) and T103 (Two Essences). The celestial concentration thus falls roughly in the first quarter (T3-T25) with a tight peak at T19-T22.
degree_descent.spiritual_range: Spiritual operative teachings dominate T4-T48 broadly: Four Days (T4), Four Faces (T5), Ten Chariots (T8), Five Mysteries (T9), Five Awakeners (T13), Twelve Greatnesses (T15), Three Ages (T16), Four Wars (T17), Four Salvations (T18), Hyle (T23), Twelve Judges (T28), Twelve Thrones (T29), Living Spirit's works (T30-T37), Three Days/Two Deaths (T41), strippings and separations (T44-T48). Late spiritual returns at T54, T55, T59-T63, T100.
degree_descent.natural_range: Natural register dominates T56-T99 (Adam and Eve molded, senses as city, lifespan, sun/moon, fire, zodiac, cosmos as body, elements gathering, names of garments, Hyle's envy, paths to corruption, cloud and rain, three births, virgin/continent, pearl in sea, body's offspring, eye, soul in sickness). Earlier natural intrusions at T1-T2 (prelude), T6 (Five Worlds), T27 (King of Darkness), T38-T40 (cosmic body, Adam, soul in body), T49-T53 (star wheel, rain, garments).
degree_descent.degree_transitions: Major seams: (1) After T2 — prelude ends, T3 opens the explicit three-degree celestial articulation. (2) After T22 — the tight celestial cluster ends; T23 turns to Hyle's corruption. (3) After T48 — the long spiritual-operative sequence (wars, judges, strippings, separations) ends; T49 turns to the star-wheel binding falsity in the cosmic circuit. (4) After T55 — Two Essences cosmogonic-spiritual closes; T56 opens the extended molding-of-Adam-and-Eve natural section that runs through T99. (5) After T99 — closing summary begins with T100 (spiritual recap of First Man's prayer). Transitions are gradual rather than sharp; the corpus drifts through registers.
degree_descent.counterexamples: T1-T2 are not strict celestial — T1 is a creation-fall fragment ending at Adam's eyes opening (natural tone), and T2 treats the architecture of Life and Death as five-faculty trees (touches every register but operates at the natural-rational interface). T6 (Five Worlds of Darkness) is natural-register anatomy at position 6 — a major early exception. T27 (Five Forms in King of Darkness) is natural-register at mid-corpus. T38-T40 (cosmos as great human body, Adam from Watchers' children, soul bound in twelve members) are strongly natural at mid-corpus. T64 (Love as bond of Greatness, Hatred as first death) is a celestial-register definition appearing late. T103 (Two Substances from beginning) is foundational celestial dualism at near-final position. T100 (First Man's prayer and threefold sending) is a spiritual-register recap appearing in the closing block. These are not local exceptions but real interruptions of a clean descent.

directional_winding.celestial_winding: The tight celestial cluster T19-T22 is dominantly EAST-toned: T19 defines what Greatness IS as bearing realm, T20 treats the Father's interior structure of five members, T21 describes the Land of Light in its perfect being, T22 contemplates the unchanging stillness — all asking 'what does the celestial source IS at its root.' T3 (descent through three degrees) and T7 (five fathers descent) carry SOUTH-tone (wisdom unfolding the source through articulated levels). T11 (Chain of Origins) is EAST. T25 (emanations from Five Members) is SOUTH. There is no clean east → south → north → west rotation; the celestial range is EAST-dominant with secondary SOUTH, lacking the predicted NORTH and WEST stations.
directional_winding.spiritual_winding: T13-T18 are NORTH-heavy (resurrection-drawings, ages, wars, salvations — all discriminating operations). T23 (Hyle's self-begetting) drops to WEST. T26-T32 are SOUTH-toned (parables of likeness, anatomy of descent, seven works, three garments — wisdom unfolding the operations). T28-T29 (judges, thrones) are NORTH. T33-T34 (works built into archons) are WEST (built structures). T41-T48 are NORTH-dominant (three plagues, three malformations, four ages of separation — discriminative operations). The spiritual range thus has NORTH and SOUTH most strongly, with WEST appearing in built-structure teachings, but again not as a clean rotation. EAST-tone is rare in the spiritual range (T9, T59, T60 — the love-content teachings).
directional_winding.natural_winding: T49-T70 trends NORTH (star wheel, zodiac, cosmic mechanism, judicial mirror) interleaved with WEST (T56-T58 body and senses; T65 Adam as sealed icon; T68 sunrise/sunset as ultimates; T71 cosmos as body). T72-T78 mix SOUTH and WEST (gathering, garments, peace-letters, kingdoms, sin's works). T79-T99 oscillates NORTH (purification, hidden host, paths, corruption, eye) and WEST (body's offspring, three icons, pearl). Strong WEST signature in body-as-vessel teachings (T57, T71, T81, T99). Some EAST-tone in T75 (Five Living Fires) and T59-T60 (the griefs/weepings — embedded earlier). The natural range trends WEST overall as expected for the ultimate degree, with NORTH active in the discriminating zodiacal and judgment-of-flesh teachings.
directional_winding.counterexamples: Within celestial range, no NORTH or WEST station is present, breaking the predicted four-way rotation. Within the natural body-section, the rotation if any runs more like NORTH → WEST → SOUTH → NORTH rather than the predicted east → south → north → west. The directional sequence within each degree does not show a clean rotation; instead each degree has a dominant tone with secondary tones. Small local windings can be detected (e.g., T28 NORTH → T30 SOUTH → T33 WEST suggests a partial rotation in the spiritual middle), but they do not align with the predicted four-fold sequence.

T6 (§288-§389): five worlds of darkness with five archons, five spirits, five bodies, five trees, five tastes/metals — the proprium articulated five-fold
T7 (§390-§452): five Fathers each with three emanations — the Lord's accommodation in five discrete degrees
T9 (§474-§575): five mysteries (peace, salutation, kiss, right hand, chirotonia) operating on three planes
T20 (§1206-§1235): five members of light of the First Father plus five attributes gushing forth into the aeons
T25 (§1588-§1594): five emanations from the Father's five faculties (Beloved from mind, Mother of Life from thought, Beloved from teaching, Virgin from counsel, fifth from reflection)
T27 (§1622-§1671): five bestial members in body of King of Darkness (lion-head, eagle-wings, demon-feet, dark belly, fish-loins)
T40 (§2185-§2287): five somatic substrates (bone, sinew, vein, flesh, skin) binding the soul's five faculties + five virtues + five overlords = the twelvefold structure

T75 (§4434-§4474): Living Fire at eight places — seven plus an eighth, fivefold articulated through the cosmos and man
fivefold_constitution.notes: The five-fold constitution is fully pervasive throughout the corpus and operates at every register: celestial (T20 — Father's five members; T25 — five emanations), spiritual (T9, T13, T31-T33 — five mysteries, awakeners, faculties, works), and natural (T6, T27, T40, T58, T70, T87-T90 — five worlds of darkness, five forms in body, five somatic substrates, five lords of sphere, twelve zodia from five worlds, five offspring of body). This pervasive five-fold structure at every register is consistent with the body's radial five-fold constitution at every point — itself the strongest evidence that the corpus is organized as the Grand Man. The fives are not concentrated in any one section but radiate through the whole, supporting the Grand Man hypothesis on grounds independent of the linear descent.

natural_seams.what_shifts: The creation-fall prelude ends. T3 opens with the explicit three-degree articulation — Goodness, Wisdom, Power at Father → aeons → elements — establishing the architectural celestial register that will dominate the early section.

The tight celestial concentration (T19 Greatness, T20 First Father, T21 Land of Light, T22 Eternity) ends. T23 turns to Hyle's self-begetting and the dynamic of corruption — a sharp shift from the unchanging celestial substance to the dynamic of mingling.

The long sequence of providential anticipations and separations-forth (T43-T48) ends. T49 opens the cosmic-mechanism section: the star-wheel as binding-engine, the zodiac, the rain-channels — a shift from the SPIRITUAL operations of stripping and judgment to the NATURAL apparatus that holds those operations in place.

T55 (Two Essences and the building of firmaments as palace) closes the cosmogonic-spiritual building. T56 opens the molding of Adam and Eve — the start of the long extended natural-register block on body, senses, cosmos-as-body that runs through T99. This is the deepest seam in the corpus.

The extended natural body-and-cosmos section ends. T100 returns to the spiritual register with the threefold prayer and threefold sending — a recap of the redemptive structure. T101-T104 close as a heterogeneous coda: pruning the body's tips (T101), mystical seeing (T102), Two Essences from the beginning (T103), Yes-and-Amen as Call-and-Hearing (T104). The closing block touches all three registers as a summary.

structural_ribs.name: Five-fold articulation everywhere
structural_ribs.evidence: The number five appears as the structural backbone at every register — five faculties (T2, T20, T25, T31), five Sons of First Man (T9, T15, T31, T62, T65), five worlds of darkness (T6, T14, T27, T40, T70), five mysteries/awakeners/garments/works (T9, T13, T33, T49, T53, T62, T69, T78, T94), five Living Fires (T75), five offspring (T90), five elements (T93), five faculties of senses (T57). This is independent confirmation of the Grand Man architecture (radial five-fold at every point).

structural_ribs.name: Father → Mother of Life → First Man → Living Spirit → Ambassador → Jesus the Radiance (the descending cast)
structural_ribs.evidence: The same six-fold cast of divine persons appears in nearly every architectural teaching, each named at its station. T4 names them as Four Days; T7 as Five Fathers; T15 as Twelve Greatnesses arranged as five; T17 as Four Wars; T18 as Four Salvations; T25 as five emanations from the Father; T100 as a threefold prayer met by threefold sending. The cast is a stable backbone throughout.

structural_ribs.name: Pillar of Glory / Perfect Man as the column of return
structural_ribs.evidence: The Pillar of Glory recurs as the axis of accumulated truth from T2 (climax of the Beautiful Tree) through T104 (the standing apparatus). It functions at every register: as celestial bearing-realm (T19), as spiritual axis of ascent (T7, T13, T15), and as natural cosmic support (T31, T33, T39, T63). The recurring rib unites the corpus along its vertical axis.

structural_ribs.name: Call and Hearing / Yes and Amen
structural_ribs.evidence: The conjugate pair of summons-and-response runs throughout. T8 (Call worn as garment); T10 (Five with the Two = Seven); T18 (Great Counsel as Call-with-Hearing); T31 (descent of the Call); T76 (cosmic correspondence as letters of peace); T89 (Call inverted as reflected face, Answer as righted face); T94 (Pentecost — fifty days of Call meeting Answer); T104 (Yes = Calling, Amen = Hearing). The corpus closes (T104) by naming this pair as the principle by which the cosmos is held open.

structural_ribs.name: Mind of Light awakening illumined understanding
structural_ribs.evidence: The Mind of Light functions as the awakening rational understanding through which regeneration completes. T2 (climax of Beautiful Tree); T11 (Origin of all wisdoms, opening eight-fold); T12 (the five sayings make a foundation for the Mind of Light); T13 (fourth drawer-upward); T39-T40 (Mind of Light rooted in body, humbling Sin); T57 (taking keys of senses); T99 (in the pneumatic icon).

structural_ribs.name: Hyle / Enthumesis of Death as the corrupt counter-matrix
structural_ribs.evidence: Hyle as the counterfeit Mother appears throughout as the negative pole. T6 (her vehicles and concealments); T14 (her gushing-forth); T23 (her solitary self-begetting of cosmos); T46 (her enthumesis fashioning the dragon-Error); T56 (the archons' molding via Hyle); T74 (her envy as primal nature); T87 (the three begettings as her extrusions); T88 (the dragon as enthumesis of body). The constancy of this rib mirrors the stability of the divine cast.

structural_ribs.name: Cross of Light / Living Soul dispersed in matter
structural_ribs.evidence: The dispersed Living Soul (Five Sons crucified in matter, redemptive operation working from below) recurs as the central drama. T16, T17 (planted as Living Soul); T32 (crucified one spread in every body); T64 (Living Soul killed by hatred); T68 (creatures emerging onto Cross of Light at sunrise); T82 (Cross of Light beneath stars); T83 (every body bears Cross of Light); T91 (drawn taut in tree and thorn); T101 (members as bearers of Living Soul). The redemptive ascent operates wherever this rib is.

structural_ribs.name: Ambassador's revealed icon / image
structural_ribs.evidence: The Third Ambassador's revealing operation — the icon shown to the cosmos — recurs as the central spiritual disclosure. T35 (icon manifested in glory); T56 (archons see and counterfeit it as Adam); T57 (stolen seal stamped on Adam); T65 (Adam as sealed icon); T74 (Hyle's envy of the icon); T100 (revealed before Hades). This rib structures the relation between heavenly source and counterfeit natural form.

structural_ribs.name: Ten / Twelve fullness in extension
structural_ribs.evidence: Twelve as fullness of articulation (and ten as graduated descent) recurs at every register. T4 twelve hours of each Day; T10 twelve aeons; T14 twelve dignities of error; T20 twelve members of light / wisdoms; T28 twelve judges; T29 twelve thrones; T44 twelve works of cosmic economy; T49 twelve zodia; T70 twelve zodia bound in sphere; T84 twelve graded strippings. The twelvefold articulation is stable across degrees.

structural_ribs.name: Two luminaries — sun and moon — as ships of light
structural_ribs.evidence: The two luminaries function as the standing apparatus of Divine Truth in the natural cosmos. T2 (ship of night = First Man, ship of day = Ambassador); T8 (vessel of light); T32 (ships of light in firmaments); T48 (adorned by Father of Life); T66-T68 (sun shaped after First Image; sunrise/sunset as mysteries); T75 (two luminaries as Living Fire); T82 (only luminaries with open gate); T86 (two luminaries doing farmer's work); T91 (two luminaries grieving). This is a stable rib of the natural register.

conjectures_to_avoid.claim: The corpus opens with celestial register from T1 onward.
conjectures_to_avoid.why_conjecture: T1 is a creation-fall fragment ending at Adam's eyes opening (natural register), and T2 treats the soul's architecture at the natural-rational interface. The celestial concentration does not start at the very beginning; it concentrates at T19-T25 with scattered earlier appearances (T3, T7, T11). Calling T1-T2 'celestial' would force the pattern.

conjectures_to_avoid.claim: Each teaching has a single unambiguous register.
conjectures_to_avoid.why_conjecture: Many teachings span registers — T15 (Twelve Greatnesses) traces from celestial Father to natural Adam; T41 (Three Days) covers descent, intermediate reign, and final unveiling; T100 (First Man's prayer) operates at spiritual level but reaches into all degrees. Forcing a single register flattens the actual texture.

conjectures_to_avoid.claim: The directional rotation east → south → north → west is visible at the level of consecutive teachings.
conjectures_to_avoid.why_conjecture: The actual tonal pattern within each degree is dominant-tone-with-secondary-tones, not a clean four-way rotation through consecutive positions. The celestial cluster is dominantly EAST without working through NORTH and WEST stations; the natural cluster trends WEST without a preceding clean SOUTH-NORTH sequence. To claim a four-fold rotation at the level of consecutive teachings would be reading-in.

conjectures_to_avoid.claim: T103 (Two Essences) at position 103 is a structural anomaly.
conjectures_to_avoid.why_conjecture: It might be — but it might also be an intentional recapitulation, a circular return to source as the corpus closes. Without independent confirmation that the order is original-and-undisturbed, calling T103 an anomaly is interpretive rather than architectural.

conjectures_to_avoid.claim: The natural register dominance from T56-T99 reflects the body / feet / ultimate degree of the Grand Man.
conjectures_to_avoid.why_conjecture: It strongly correlates with that prediction, and is the cleanest evidence of descent in the corpus. But it could also reflect topical groupings (the cosmic-as-body, sun-and-moon, sense-anatomy themes simply cluster) without being driven by a Grand-Man descent. Both readings fit; the descent reading is supported but not uniquely confirmed.

conjectures_to_avoid.claim: T100's appearance late is a return-to-source closure.
conjectures_to_avoid.why_conjecture: T100's threefold prayer/threefold sending recap could be a structural return, but it could equally be a thematic placement of a long teaching about the First Man's distress that simply happens to fall there. The closing structure of T100-T104 is ambiguous and the descent reading should not over-interpret it.

open_questions: Could T1-T2 be an introductory 'overture' (creation-fall + soul-architecture) that frames the descent rather than starting it? If so, the descent proper would begin at T3 (Three Principles at Three Degrees) — a much cleaner celestial opening.

Why does the celestial concentration peak at T19-T25 rather than at the very opening? Is this because the corpus first articulates the descending cast (T3-T18) and only then returns to dwell on the inmost source (T19-T25), forming a 'celestial heart' inside the early architecture?

Why does T64 (Love as bond of Greatness, Hatred as first death) appear in the natural section if it operates at the celestial register? Is this a deliberate sourcing-back from natural treatment of love and hatred to their celestial origin?

Is the closing block T100-T104 a deliberate inverse-mirror of the opening? T100 (spiritual prayer) ↔ T9-T18 spiritual operations? T103 (Two Essences) ↔ T1 (creation mingling)? T104 (Yes and Amen / Call and Hearing) ↔ T8-T9 Call mysteries?
Within the natural body-section (T56-T99), is there a finer ordering by faculty (will/love → understanding/wisdom → rational → ultimate body) that I am missing because the section is so long?
How much of the rough-rather-than-clean descent reflects scribal/redactional disturbance of an originally cleaner order, versus a feature of the original architecture?

Does the natural-register dominance in the latter half (T56-T99) reflect the larger 'feet' of the Grand Man (which would naturally take more text to articulate)? Or is it simply that the body, senses, and cosmos provide more material to discuss?
scope: I read the arc-and-reading-summary of all 104 teachings in sequence and assessed each for: (a) the register at which it predominantly operates (celestial / spiritual / natural), based on what the teaching TREATS; and (b) the directional tone it carries (east-love / south-wisdom / north-rational / west-ultimates), based on whether the teaching addresses what the thing IS at source, how it unfolds in truth, how it is discriminated, or how it appears in concrete form. I then traced register-trends across the sequence, identified natural seams, located cross-corpus structural ribs, and tested whether the reading order tracks the predicted celestial-to-spiritual-to-natural descent of influx through the Grand Man.
summary: Yes — the reading order of the 104 teachings roughly tracks the descent of influx through the Grand Man, but with significant turbulence rather than clean linearity. The pattern is most clearly visible at the largest scale: the early section (especially T3-T25) concentrates celestial-register material on the Father, the Greatness, the Land of Light, eternity, and the inmost emanations; the middle section (T26-T55) is dominated by spiritual-register operations (judges, thrones, building works, strippings, separations, garments of the Living Spirit, the cosmogonic war); and the latter section (T56-T99) is overwhelmingly natural-register — the molding of Adam and Eve, the body as city of senses, the sun and moon, the zodiac, the cosmos-as-body, the body's offspring, the elements in flesh, mystical seeing in sickness. This three-zone shape is real and visible. The descent is rough rather than clean because of three kinds of exception: (1) an introductory pair T1-T2 that operates at natural-rational tone before the celestial articulation begins; (2) earlier intrusions of natural-register anatomy at T6 (Five Worlds of Darkness), T27 (King of Darkness body), T38-T40 (cosmic body, Adam molded, soul in body); and (3) late returns to celestial register at T64 (love as bond of Greatness) and T103 (Two Essences). Within each degree, a four-way directional rotation east → south → north → west is NOT cleanly visible at the level of consecutive teachings — instead each degree shows a dominant tone (celestial = EAST, spiritual = NORTH/SOUTH, natural = WEST) with secondary tones interleaved. The five-fold constitution is fully pervasive throughout the corpus and operates at every register, providing strong independent support for the Grand Man architecture. The descent through three degrees is roughly present; the four-direction winding within each degree is visible only at the level of dominant tone, not as consecutive rotation.
